title: The Lockheed CL-282: three-view line drawing of proposed reconnaissance aircraft
description: Technical line drawing showing the Lockheed CL-282 in plan (top), front, and side views, depicting a long straight high-aspect-ratio wing on an F-104-style fuselage with a T-tail. Captioned "The Lockheed CL-282." Accompanying text recounts General LeMay's dismissal of the design and its rejection by the Wright Air Development Command in June 1954.
